name: Average full-time adjusted salary, national currency
description: Gross wages and salaries per employee, adjusted to full-time equivalents (national accounts D.11 / employees x LFS FTE ratio), in national currency. Primary wage indicator: basis for nominal and real wage growth, free of exchange-rate effects.
notes: Use for growth rates only: levels are in different currencies. Euro area members are shown in euro for all years, converted at the irrevocable rate (e.g. HR kuna / 7.5345); BG (euro from 2026) is still in lev in the current release. Netherlands not published by Eurostat (different national method). Possible unflagged LFS breaks, e.g. 2020-2021 for some countries.

name: Average full-time adjusted salary, EUR
description: Gross wages and salaries per employee, adjusted to full-time equivalents (national accounts D.11 / employees x LFS FTE ratio), in euro. For comparing wage levels between countries.
notes: Non-euro countries are converted at market exchange rates, so growth in EUR includes exchange-rate movements; use WAGE_NAC for growth. Netherlands not published by Eurostat (different national method). Possible unflagged LFS breaks, e.g. 2020-2021 for some countries.

name: Net earnings (single person)
description: Annual net earnings of a single person without children earning 100% of the average wage. Secondary indicator for net take-home pay.
notes: Break in series from 2024: compiler changed from OECD to JRC (EUROMOD); 2024 values are on a monthly scale and 2025 is on a new basis. Used only up to 2023 (valid_to_year); raw keeps all years. Croatia and EU27_2020 start in 2013, Cyprus in 2014.

name: Consumer price index (HICP)
description: Harmonised index of consumer prices, all items, monthly index (2025 = 100). Basis for annual inflation: annual average index / previous year's annual average index - 1.
notes: Reference base 2025 = 100, as in Eurostat's annual HICP (prc_hicp_ainr); the index-derived annual rates match Eurostat's official annual average rates (prc_hicp_ainr). Latest month is often a flash estimate (e).

name: Inflation (HICP)
unit: % change on same month of previous year
description: Harmonised index of consumer prices, all items: annual rate of change.
notes: ECOICOP ver.2 dataset with back-cast history; replaces the discontinued prc_hicp_manr (ends 2025-12). Latest month is often flagged e (estimated).

name: House price index
description: House price index for all dwellings (new and existing), 2015 = 100.
notes: Greece (EL) not available: Greece does not report a house price index to Eurostat. Latest quarter is often provisional (p).

name: Unemployment rate
description: Unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted, total (both sexes, ages 15-74), % of the labour force.

name: GDP per capita (PPS)
description: Gross domestic product per inhabitant in purchasing power standards (EU27_2020 basis), current prices.
